_comment: Roles this instance owns outright (`roles`: `fhir-modeller`, `ig-publisher-service`, moved here from cat-harness in placement PR4, bean 4fv8) and role EXTENSIONS by id (`extensions`, placement PR0b; PR1, bean ybwt). Each extension adds this instance's skills to a role the harness declares, so the edge points DOWN: the harness's scenarios/roles.json names no skill that lives above it. Schema: cat-harness/schemas/process/role-graph.ts; overlay: cat-harness/schemas/process/scenario-overlay.ts.
name: fhir-harness

roles.title: FHIR modeller
roles.description: Authors the L3 profiles, extensions and examples an IG is built from.
roles.persona: Builds the L3 profiles. Fluent in FHIR and in the tooling; wants the model's constraints and invariants, not an introduction to the resource.

roles.title: IG publisher + validator
roles.description: The JVM services an IG build shells out to. External in behaviour, internal in configuration.
